global_followups_not_counted_as_16_endpo.detail: Rust retry now consumes the Idempotency-Key header, but still requires request.reason. Old Python tests allow POST /api/background-jobs/{job_id}/retry with an empty JSON body for supported job types.
global_followups_not_counted_as_16_endpo.required_next_action: Make reason optional for retry or document an approved replacement contract before adding retry to platform runtime shadow scope.

global_followups_not_counted_as_16_endpo.detail: Old Python settings write synchronously calls OARoleSyncService.sync_access_control and rolls it back on persistence failure. Rust stores versioned PostgreSQL settings facts with audit/idempotency but does not synchronously provision OA roles.
global_followups_not_counted_as_16_endpo.decision_question: Should OA role sync remain part of POST /api/workbench/settings, or move to an async identity/role provisioning workflow?
global_followups_not_counted_as_16_endpo.recommended_decision: Move OA role provisioning to an audited async task/outbox workflow; keep settings write as PostgreSQL fact persistence plus read-model invalidation, and expose role-provisioning health separately.

global_followups_not_counted_as_16_endpo.detail: API request path is intentionally queue-only. Prompt04 runtime shadow proves request contract equivalence, but destructive worker execution still requires separate staging worker proof, approval evidence, backup evidence, and rollback/PITR drill before production cutover.
